sector_model: Advertising-funded consumer internet (small cap): CPC auction revenue, paying advertiser locations, SBC-heavy cash flow, buybacks; generic FCF model with SBC deducted.
thesis: Yelp (NYSE: YELP), Q3 2026 10-Q filed 2026-11-06 (statements, MD&A overview/outlook excerpts, liabilities, legal read; 10-K not read). Net revenue Q3 370.9M vs 376.0M (-1.4%), 9M 1,107.9M vs 1,105.0M (+0.3%); paying locations 509K vs 512K (-1%), Services -4%. TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 1,467.9M, NI 121.7M, OCF 318.1M, capex 55.0M, FCF 263.0M; SBC TTM 108.2M leaves 154.8M. Shares 54,492,897 (cover 2026-10-30) x 20.14 (2026-11-17 close) = market cap 1,097.5M = 9.0x TTM NI, FCF yield 24.0% (14.1% after SBC). Revolver 75.0M, cash 119.8M (net cash about 44.8M), EV about 1,052.7M = 0.72x TTM revenue. The price implies advertising revenue keeps shrinking and FCF falls well below the TTM level; evidence for a different view: 9M FCF is still 190.8M and 200.1M of stock was repurchased in 9M, retiring about 9% of shares (59.99M to 54.47M issued since 2025-12-31).
counterthesis: Management says adverse advertising conditions persist with a modest Q4 revenue decline and rising Q4 expenses (Hatch, Yelp Host); other revenue (AI products) targets a 250M run rate only by end 2028. 9M FCF fell to 190.8M from 251.4M (-24%) and adjusted EBITDA to 263.1M from 283.5M. Heavy buybacks were partly funded by 75M net revolver borrowing (165M drawn, 90M repaid in 9M) and the cash pile dropped from 216.1M plus 103.3M securities at year-end to 119.8M, so the cheap multiple may reflect a shrinking core and AI search disintermediation. SBC is 7% of revenue. 9M investing outflow 199.0M (acquisitions incl. RepairPal-related items, not itemised here) suggests purchased growth. Cause of the share price level and recent move unconfirmed.
invalidation: Thesis of a mispriced cash generator fails if net revenue declines more than about 5% year on year, paying locations fall further, FCF after SBC drops below about 100M, or leverage-funded buybacks continue while core advertising shrinks.
